The patch moves attempt accounting into `Complete` and adds an explicit unclassified completion for early exits. I’m tracing the receive loop now to check that each path calls it once, and that the existing policy and error ordering still hold.
The receive loop appears to account for every delivered job once: early host and evidence exits use an unclassified completion, while success, cancellation, and failure use classified completions. The initial full-host failure is isolated to an unchanged execution test; I’m checking the retained retries and lint diagnostics before deciding whether that limits the task verdict.
## Findings

No surviving findings were introduced by the task 3 patch. `Complete` updates active work, attempted attempts, classification counters, and failure policy in one transition. The Runner paths reviewed call it once per received job; early exits retain an attempted but unclassified result. The first, budget, and all policies, ordinal scheduling, error precedence, and comments remain consistent with the preimages.
